description:
The original Fable trilogy gave players a choice between actions that were defined as either good or evil. Playground Games' Fable reboot is retaining a morality system, but it's not going to be quite so simple and binary. Instead, players will be able to have more nuanced characters who may not necessarily be either good or evil.

"Morality was always such an important part of the original trilogy," said Fable general manager and director Ralph Fulton during an interview with Xbox Wire. "I think that original trilogy is inextricably linked with the concept of good and evil--but I think morality in video games has moved on in the intervening period. How we think about morality in the world today has really informed how we wanted to represent it as a game system in this game. That’s
title: Fable Is Going Deeper With Its Morality Scale

description: Hypixel's long-awaited survival-crafting game has finally moved beyond its existence as merely a popular Minecraft server to become… a surprisingly familiar Minecraft clone.
title: Hytale Early Access Review - Mining The Past

description:
When you first see or download Hytale, the first thing that likely pops into your mind is how much it looks like Minecraft. The inspiration is obvious, as the developers are former Minecraft modders and wanted to make something similar to the game that changed the industry forever. However, while the two games are extremely alike on the surface, Hytale features several key differences that separate it from Minecraft.

Below, we've listed seven of the biggest differences from Minecraft that you'll experience when playing Hytale. Some of these differences are readily apparent and in-game now, while others are currently planned and will take time to develop, as Hytale is still in early access. If you're ready to jump into Hypixel's new sandbox, be sure to use our
title: Hytale Vs. Minecraft - 7 Differences Between The Two Sandboxes

description:
Playground's new Fable game will have an "amazing cast," game director Ralph Fulton has said. In an interview, Fulton teased that the new Fable game will carry forward the franchise's tradition of working with popular actors, though he didn't name anyone outright as of yet.

"We have an amazing cast in this game--and we'll talk more about the cast in future," he said in an interview with Xbox. "Again, that's in keeping with the original Fable games."

He said the casting for the earlier Fable games from Lionhead was so strong that it felt like a "challenge" for Playground to live up.

Continue Reading
title: New Fable Will Have An "Amazing Cast" And Lots Of British Humor, Director Says

description:
The new Fable game from Playground Games is coming to PlayStation 5, and that's a big deal because the series has never landed on a Sony system. Playground's other big game for 2026, Forza Horizon 6, is also landing on PS5 following the huge success of Forza Horizon 5 on PS5. The new Fable is landing on PS5 alongside the Xbox and PC editions, but Forza Horizon 6 won't come to PS5 until some point after it releases on Xbox and PC. Why is that?

Fable game director Ralph Fulton told IGN that, "Every project team is deciding these things; deciding what's right for their particular t
title: Fable And Forza Horizon 6 Are Coming To PS5 To Help Reach The "Largest Number Of People Possible"

description:
During Xbox's Developer Direct, Forza Horizon developer Playground Games more fully showed off its Fable reboot. The game's visuals are impressive, but the real achievement of the dev team may be the open world and people who live in it. According to Playground Games, there are over 1,000 NPCs in Fable, and players can talk to and interact with all of them.

"You can talk to them, you can romance them, you can marry them," said Fable general manager Ralph Fulton. "You can divorce them or be divorced by them. You can have children with them. You can hire them. You can fire them. [NPCs] are kind of a game within a game, but they are such a unique, fundamental part of Fable. And I think one of the things that sets Fable apart from other open-world medieval fantasy RPGs is that it was
title: Fable's New Open World Has 1,000+ NPCS As A "Living Population"

description:
A new Fable game is coming this year from developer Playground. It's the first new entry in the series following the closure of original developer Lionhead and the departure of series director Peter Molyneux from Microsoft.

Playground is not trying to "ape" anything that Lionhead did, game director Ralph Fulton said in an interview. Instead, the developer said it was important for the new game to be a reboot so Playground could put its own stamp on Fable--while retaining elements of the original games, like morality and kicking chickens.
title: New Fable Isn't Trying To "Ape" What OG Developer Lionhead Did

description:
The Fable series is known for a lot of things, including the ability to kick chickens and send them soaring through the air. The new Fable, from developer Playground, will continue to allow you to do this, it was confirmed as part of Xbox Developer Direct.

In an interview with Xbox, game director Ralph Fulton said if NPCs in the world see you kicking chickens, you'll begin to earn a reputation as a "Chicken Chaser." If enough people witness you kicking chickens, or if you just do it a lot, your reputation in a given settlement will be that you're a person who likes to kick chickens. "People will react to you based on what they think about that particular reputation," Fulton said.

However, different people will take this reputation to mean different thing
title: New Fable Keeps Series Tradition Of Kicking Chickens Alive, And You'll Be Judged For It

description:
After last year's critically acclaimed sleeper Keeper, Double Fine is coming back with a new take on an older game. During the Xbox Developer Direct, Double Fine officially unveiled Kiln, a title where players will be able to make unique pottery warriors and send them into battle against each other.

During the much-longer look at Kiln from the Xbox Developer Direct, it was clear that the vase creation has a lot of options for players to shape their warriors and guide their destructive destinies. Ho
title: Double Fine's New Game, Kiln, Features Pottery Battles To The Death

description:
The new Fable game that Microsoft showed off during the Xbox Developer Direct takes inspiration from an unlikely source: the popular TV show The Office.

Game director Ralph Fulton said in an interview with Xbox that British humor "manifests in lots of different ways throughout the game." The team at Playground, which is based in England, was inspired by the "rich variety of British comedies" of the past two decades, including Ricky Gervais' The Office, as well as Peep Show, The IT Crowd, and others.

"We started with The Office, which again started out as quintessentially British, but also travels really, really well," he said, no doubt referencing the American version that elevated the series to new heights. "Not just that IP, but a lot of the techniques
title: Fable Is Pulling Inspiration From An Unlikely (And Extremely Popular) TV Show

description:
Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, Premium, and Essential subscribers can start the weekend a little early, because the next Free Play Days event begins today, January 22 and goes through Sunday, January 25. One of the four games available to players is South Park: Snow Day!, which seems appropriate given the cold weather sweeping much of the US.

South Park: Snow Day!

Snow Day! is a four-player co-op title that casts players as the new kid in town opposite Cartman, Stan, Kyle, and Kenny. A blizzard has blown through South Park, and set the boys off into a fantasy realm of adventure where they g
title: Snowed In? South Park: Snow Day And More Are Free On Xbox This Weekend

description:
Raven Software has released a new post on social media to discuss Call of Duty: Warzone's upcoming Season 2 update and the focus on more competitive play. This includes the return of Ranked Play and the introduction of a new game mode inspired by Warzone's previous Iron Trials.

Call of Duty's competitive Ranked Play mode was removed with the launch of Black Ops 7, but the upcoming Season 2 update will add Ranked Play: Resurgence back to the game. Warzone currently has two Resurgence maps: Rebirth Island and Haven's Hollow. The developer did not confirm which map would be featured for Ranked Play for Season 2, but in past seasons, Ranked Play: Resurgence took place on Rebirth Island.

Additionally, the developer will introduce a beta version of a new mode called Iron Gauntlet, which it says is a competitive e
title: CoD: Warzone Aims To Be More Competitive In Season 2

description:
Fable has been talked about for years, but rarely seen. That finally changed during today's Developer Direct, as Forza Horizon developer Playground Games showed off more of the long-in-development fantasy adventure in action, which is due for release in Fall 2026, including on PS5.

Continue Reading at GameSpot
title: Fable Releases This Autumn, Coming To PS5 At Launch

description:
Arc Raiders was one of 2025's biggest success stories, and the game is still putting up big numbers in 2026. The game was also controversial in some circles for how the developers used an AI-enabled text-to-speech system for some of its dialogue, just like the studio did for its previous game, The Finals.

Benson Russell, a veteran game developer who has worked on Call of Duty, The Last of Us, and Uncharted during his career, has now said he believes the way Arc Raiders uses AI is a "perfect" example of how it can be done right.

Russell said in an interview with 80LV "utility dialogue systems" have been "a bit of a thorn" for developers throughout the years. "The problem space is that we want to give information to
title: How Arc Raiders Implements AI Is A "Perfect" Use Of The Tech, Dev Says

description:
Pokemon developer Game Freak is working on the post-apocalyptic adventure Beast of Reincarnation, and during the Developer Direct this week, it showed off more of the game, its protagonist Emma, and her journey across a blighted land alongside her canine companion, Koo.

The new look at the game showed off more of the massive tree-like behemoths that players will encounter, but fortunately, they'll have samurai skills and an arsenal of magical abilities that can be used to prune the killer flora.

Set in the far-off year of 4,026, Beast of Reincarnation puts you in the boots of Emma the Sealer, an outcast who has been prophesied to slay the titular Beast of Reincarnation. Built around demanding and technical combat, Emma and Koo will have to push deeper into the unknown to strengthen their bond and awaken new powers.
title: Beast Of Reincarnation Doesn't Look Like Anything Game Freak Has Made Before

description:
It looks like last week's leak was accurate, as Forza Horizon 6 will hit the streets on May 19 for PC and Xbox Series X|S. During today's Developer Direct livestream, Microsoft confirmed the release date for the racing game, which shifts the Horizon Festival from Mexico to Japan.

The Developer Direct livestream showed off official gameplay for Forza Horizon 6. Just like the previous games, the arcade racer looks like a slick celebration of speed, but this time, all the action is taking place across Japan and its legendary twisty roads.

Forza Horizon 6 will reflect the culture of Japan and its storied history with street racing. The game's hub will feature the numbers "78" emblazoned on the side of the hangar, which are considered fortunate in Japanese culture and part of the pro
title: Forza Horizon 6 Gets Official May Release Date, More Than 550 Cars

description:
Xbox is setting the stage for 2026 early with its fourth Developer Direct, bringing new gameplay footage and developer insights for Playground Games’ Fable and Forza Horizon 6, as well as Game Freak’s Beast of Reincarnation. While nothing else has been confirmed yet, we're hoping for a surprise fourth game to also be shown off as a pleasant "just one more thing" to end the show with.

Like previous Developer Directs, each game will be shown off by the people making them, directly from their respective studios. If you can't make it, we'll round up the highlights from the livestream below, so you can hit F5 for a quick refresh and see the news as it happens.


Forza Horizon 6 is out in May
title: Xbox Developer Direct 2026: All The Big Announcements

description:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is considered one of the best RPGs of all time, but community members have still managed to design some incredible mods that alter, expand on, and improve it. Mods for The Witcher 3 range from quality-of-life changes, to redesigns of gameplay mechanics, to full-on DLC add-ons with new quests and content. While The Witcher 3 doesn't have quite the expansive library of mods that Skyrim or Fallout 4 do on Nexus Mods, there are still dozens that make the game better in one way or another.

Below, you can see our picks for the 28 best mods to download for The Witcher 3. The mods are listed in no
title: Best Witcher 3 Mods To Download In 2026

description:
The original Subnautica is one of the best survival games to ever arrive in the genre, but that doesn't mean you can't improve the vanilla version with a few of the top mods made by the community. While the Subnautica modding community doesn't feature expansive, DLC-sized mods like some other game sections on Nexus Mods, there are hundreds of useful, quality-of-life mods that can enhance your experience on Planet 4546B. From inventory management improvements to better base building to full-on new vehicles, you can find a slew of mods to make Subnautica a better overall game.

We'll be going over the best Subnautica mods that you can find on Nexus Mods. As a note, this only includes the original game
title: 22 Best Subnautica Mods To Download In 2026

description:
Rust remains one of the most popular survival games in 2026, but there are plenty of other games on the market that emulate some or even all of what it has to offer. With Rust encompassing several different genres, you can find and play a variety of different games to get a similar experience to the one found on one of Rust's many servers.

Of course, searching out what those games might be can be a little difficult. While we do have a list of the best survival games to play in 2026, Rust is also a PvP shooter with base-building elements, world exploration, and several other aspects that make it stand out from other games in that genre. That said, we have put together a list of games that are like Rus
title: Best Games Like Rust To Explore In 2026

description:
Ghost of Tsushima is an absolute marvel of a game that takes you on a beautiful and dangerous journey across 13th-century Japan. While Ghost of Tsushima is a unique game in its own right, there are several other games like it that offer a similar experience in more ways than one. Whether it's the Japanese setting, the combat, the world exploration, or the storytelling of Ghosts of Tsushima, you can play a handful of other games to recapture the same feelings you had when you first stepped into the shoes of Jin Sakai.

Today, we'll be listing 17 games like Ghost of Tsushima to play after you've rolled credits and are looking for a similar experience. These games don't necessarily have to be other top-notch RPGs, but many of them will offe
title: Best Games Like Ghost of Tsushima To Slash Your Way Through In 2026

description:
It can be difficult to discern the best Minecraft mods with so many to choose from. Mojang’s blocky sandbox game has now been charming players around the world for nearly two decades, standing strong as the best-selling game of all time. If you’re a longtime player, though, you may feel as though you’re running out of content to enjoy in vanilla Minecraft. One can only enjoy so much crafting, exploring, farming, and mining in the same biomes with the same features before they tire of it all. What better way to spice your game up in such a moment than with a few free Minecraft mods?

Minecraft gameplay mods and modpacks are no secret to most fans, but many may not know which ones to look to as the constantly expanding pool of modder-created content continues to grow. There are plenty of way
title: 44 Best Minecraft Mods To Build With In 2026

description:
While it's always a good idea to save some cash toward the end of the month, Valve's quarterly Steam sales make it very tempting to dip into those rainy day funds. Fortunately, knowing when these sales will occur has gotten easier over time, as Valve no longer keeps people guessing about the dates.

The company regularly posts dates far in advance for its sales and promotional events, and the upcoming Steam Spring Sale 2026 will run from March 19 to 26.

Beyond that, Valve has also dated several other events for the rest of the year, ranging from a fresh batch of demos being dropped in the February Next Fest to a spring sale starting in March. There'll also be promotions with specific focuses throughout the year, highlighting mystery, tower defense, and PvP games. Here's the full list of everything on the way.

Continue Reading at Gam
title: When Is The Next Steam Sale? Dates For 2026 Spring Sale And More Fests Revealed

description:
Classic racing game series Screamer is making a comeback later this year, and to set it apart from other arcade racers, developer Milestone SRL is aiming to tell a dark story that looks like it was ripped straight out of an old-school anime. Ahead of its launch, the studio uploaded a trailer showcasing new characters and several game modes, including a race against the clock in Time Attack and Checkpoint.

Screamer's single-player campaign will see players take part in The Tournament, the most ambitious--and illegal--street-racing event ever organized. Five rival teams have been selected, and their vehicles have been outfitted with a unique technology that enables both offensive and defensive actions on the streets. Each crew has its own story to explore, along with unique motivations and identities reflected in both their
title: Screamer Shows Off Burnout-Style Arcade Racing With An Anime Twist

description:
For 25 years, Steve Downes has been the voice of Master Chief in the Halo video game franchise. Although Master Chief's most constant companion is an AI called Cortana, Downes is adamantly against using AI to replace human voices in video games.

"I'm not a proponent [of AI]. I don't like it and I would prefer that it not be done," said Downes during a recent AMA appearance. "I've been very vocal about my feelings about the use of artificial intelligence, which on the one hand is inevitable and has many positive effects on show business and humanity in general. But it can also be a determent and it can also be something that deprives the actor of his work."

In this A
title: Master Chief Actor Takes A Hard Line Against AI In Voice Acting

description:
Remedy has released a new statement in support of Epic Games, praising the company for funding Alan Wake 2 after a prominent developer criticized the kinds of deals that Epic does with developers.

In a post on social media, Remedy said, "There would be no Alan Wake 2 without Epic Publishing." As announced a long time ago, Epic Games funded Alan Wake 2 with the agreement being that once development and publishing costs were made back, further revenue would be split between Epic and Remedy. Alan Wake 2 finally recouped its development costs in 2025.

Remedy's statement added, "The publishing deal with Epic was very fair to Remedy. While these complex deals can often
title: Alan Wake 2 Studio Says Deal With Epic Was "Very Fair" After Baldur's Gate Boss Speaks Out

description:
The sequel to 2014's Lego Batman 3: Beyond Gotham, Legacy of the Dark Knight, won't feature online cooperative play in a move that mirrors another Lego game developer TT Games made in 2022.

As spotted by Prima Games, publisher Warner Bros. Games posted an FAQ on its official support page. There, the publisher explained a bunch of stuff, from the content the game will have to whether the characters will be customizable. Deep within the FAQ was a question about whether the forthcoming Lego Batman game will include online co-op, to which Warner Bros. Games answered with a resounding "no" in so many words
title: Lego Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight Once Again Ditches Online Co-Op

description:
Sophie Turner will play Lara Croft in the upcoming Prime Video Tomb Raider TV series, and now she's shared more details about her take on the character, saying she won't aim to be a "sex bombshell."

"It's about her and her story and what drives her, rather than what so many people also love about her, which is how hot she is in the games and the movies," Turner told the LA Times. "But I really want to show the other side. She's so unashamedly capable. She is not a woman who hides her strengths at all."

Also in the interview, Turner said her extensive physical training for Tomb Raider has allowed her to feel feel more confident taking her children on walks in London as a single mother.
title: Tomb Raider's Sophie Turner Says Her Lara Croft Is Not A "Sex Bombshell"

description:
Nintendo has introduced team battles for Mario Kart World's Knockout Tour with a free new update. The mode previously only allowed for solo competition, but now offers three different options for cooperative contests: two teams of 12, three teams of eight, or four teams of six. It's available in local or online multiplayer.

Knockout Tour made its debut with Mario Kart World, as it's a new mode not previously seen in the long-running franchise. The race sees players battling 23 other characters over a long stretch, with checkpoints taking out four contestants at a time. It feels like being in the middle of a chase from Mad Max: Fury Road at points.

With Knockout Tour's team battles, each person on the team gets a point based on their finish. First-place winners will r
title: Mario Kart World's Knockout Tour Just Got More Intriguing With New Update

description:
Prime Video has shared new data that speaks to the success of Fallout Season 2. The company said Season 2 is Prime Video's best-performing new season since Reacher Season 3 in February 2025.

Additionally, Fallout Season is now Prime Video's No. 6 most popular season ever. It's behind The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Seasons 1 and 2, along with Reacher Seasons 2 and 3, and Fallout Season 1. Amazon also noted that 53% of viewership for Fallout Season 2 came from international markets, with the show performing especially well in the UK, Germany, and Brazil. It's also a hit with men aged 18-34, becoming one of Prime Video's top five most-watched series in that demographic.
title: Men Aged 18-34 Love Fallout Season 2, Prime Video Says

description:
After several rough years, Ubisoft is planning a major restructuring as it looks toward the future. Disappointing game sales, declining revenues, and a dip in its stock value are just some of the reasons for the reset, as the French publisher and developer behind several massive IP is aiming to "reclaim its creative leadership" in the modern era of video games. So what does the new era of Ubisoft look like? One where its games will be developed by five "Creative Houses," each organized around distinct genres and franchises.

Here's a closer look at how Ubisoft is overhauling itself.
title: Ubisoft's New Structure Explained: Inside the Publisher's Five Creative Houses

description:
Have you ever wanted to own an officially licensed Nintendo talking flower? Soon you will be able to.

After announcing the talking flower months ago, Nintendo has now shared more details about the Talking Flower inspired by Super Mario Bros. Wonder's upcoming Switch 2 edition. "Leave it to speak freely or press the button to make it talk immediately--press the button often and it might even say something special," Nintendo said.

The flower can also serve as an alarm clock to help you wake up in the morning, or you can set a bedtime reminder and it will squawk at you to please go to bed. The flower also monitors the time of day and the temperature and "won't be shy about letting you know the details."
title: Nintendo Is Selling A Talking Flower

description:
This year marks the 35th anniversary of Sonic the Hedgehog, but Sega's first Sonic project of 2026 isn't what anyone expected. Instead of revealing a new Sonic game, the official Sonic the Hedgehog YouTube page has shared a teaser trailer for a new noir-ish scripted podcast called Sonic Presents: The Chaotix Casefiles.

While Sonic will have a leading role in the story, it appears that the Chaotix--Vector the Crocodile, Espio the Chameleon, and Charmy Bee--are taking the primary focus as "the intrepid Chaotix Detective Agency." That trio of heroes made their debut
title: Sonic The Hedgehog Is Getting Scripted Noir Podcast Starring The Chaotix

description:
The Xbox Developer Direct livestream is back, and if you're looking to get a brand-new look at several big games on the way from Xbox Game Studios and its partners. Here's when you can tune in and what you can expect from this livestream.

When does the Xbox Developer Direct livestream start?

The Xbox Developer Direct will kick off at 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET / 6 PM UK today, January 22. Outside of the US, you can catch it at the following times:

  • 10 AM PT
  • 1 PM ET
  • 6 PM UK
  • 2 AM JST (January 23)
  • 4 AM AEST (January 23)

Where to watch the Xbox Developer Direct livestream
title: Xbox Developer Direct 2026: How To Watch, Start Times, And What To Expect

description:
Earlier in January, Ubisoft shut down Ubisoft Halifax and laid off 70 developers who had recently voted to unionize. But those aren't the only cuts ahead, as recently disclosed by Ubisoft. Six games have already been canceled--including the Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time remake--and Ubisoft CEO Yves Guillemot indicated that more layoffs will be coming. In response, the French video game union Solidaires Informatique has called for a half-day strike.

In the social media post below, Solidaires Informatique set its strike date for January 22, and issued the following demands to Ubisoft's management.

  • An end to the cost-reduction plan
  • Maintenance and expansion of remote work conditions
title: Game Union Calls For Strike Against Ubisoft Following Cancellations

description:
2025's best-sellers


Circana has released its latest report for US video game industry sales, covering the best-selling games of December 2025 and the full year. The big question people want to know is if Battlefield 6 would be able to topple Black Ops 7, and indeed it did--by a wide margin, too.

The data shows that although Black Ops 7 was the No. 1 best-selling game for December 2025 (representing the CoD franchise's seventh straight year being No. 1 in December), EA's Battlefield 6 outsold it for the full year. In fact, Black Ops 7 was No. 5 for the full year, and that was the franchise's lowest annual ranking for US sales since 2008.

For the full year in 2025, Battlefield 6 was the No. 1 best-selling game in the US
title: Battlefield 6 Beats Black Ops 7 And Finishes 2025 As No. 1 Best-Selling Game In The US

description:
In the last two decades, there have only been a handful of years that the Call of Duty franchise didn't finish as the No. 1 best-selling video game in the US. Following the blockbuster performance of Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 in 2024 wasn't going to be an easy feat for any game. But according to the domestic sales charts, Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 not only failed to repeat its predecessor's success, but fell to No. 5 in the US for 2025.

Circana has shared its US video game sales charts for December 2025 and the entire calendar year. According to that report, Black Ops 7 was the No. 1 best-selling game across all physical and digital platforms in December. That continued Call of Duty's seven-year streak of dominating the sales chart in December. The last time it was dethroned from its perch atop the final month of the year was when
title: Black Ops 7 Had Call Of Duty's Worst Sales Year Ranking In The US Since 2008

description:
Heading into 2025, it was widely expected that Nintendo Switch 2 would break sales records. Now that Circana has released its report on the US video game market in 2025, we have a better picture of just how well Switch 2 performed and how far ahead it is of its predecessor.

According to Circana, Switch 2 led the domestic video game hardware market in both unit and dollar sales with 4.4 million consoles in its first seven months of release. That's 94% higher than the original Switch's sales numbers at the same point in its lifespan. When compared to Sony's PlayStation 4, Switch 2 is 35% ahead of PS4's sales in the same time period.

A previous analysis by The Game Business noted that Switch 2's domestic sales plummeted 35% from November to December. Circana had also previously reported that
title: Switch 2 Reached New Sales Heights In The US In 2025
